subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: Should the remaining fix for #91212 be a channel readiness gate, a Feishu-owned reconnect drain, or a narrower transient-not-ready retry policy?
rationale: The budget-accounting bug is already fixed, but the remaining behavior crosses gateway startup scheduling, channel lifecycle semantics, and Feishu-specific live behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent recovery policy alone.

options.title: Feishu reconnect drain
options.body: Add a Feishu channel-owned drain after confirmed transport recovery, matching the existing SDK seam and avoiding a broad gateway sleep.

options.title: Gateway readiness gate
options.body: Gate generic startup recovery on a stronger channel-ready signal, accepting broader startup/recovery coupling across all channels.

options.title: Transient-not-ready retry policy
options.body: Classify startup not-ready failures as deferred retries without resetting all retry counts, preserving permanent-error behavior.

recommendation.title: Feishu reconnect drain
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu channel-owned drain after confirmed transport recovery, matching the existing SDK seam and avoiding a broad gateway sleep.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans both the outbound queue split and Feishu monitor lifecycle split, which are the central owner boundaries for this decision.
